data.body:
[P2] Preserve emergency fault-release timestamps

This filter excludes `fault_released` observations with `mode="emergency"`. If emergency release supplies the cleanup or recovery being measured, the observation evidence omits its timestamp; final evidence can instead use the later driver release acknowledgment. Requirements 3 and 4 can consequently pass even though their contract forbids release-assisted cleanup regardless of mode. Include emergency receipts when computing the earliest release time, and add a regression where emergency release precedes the asserted task exit or recovery.
